ns2:section.sectionText: A seminar on the mechanisms of brain evolution in which we read through Georg Streidter's "Principles of Brain Evolution" and discuss the history of and contemporary pursuits in evolutionary neuroscience.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Biol-Ecol Ethol& Evol -UIUC, PHD:Biol-Ecol Ethol& Evl -UIUC, MS:Plant Biology -UIUC, PHD:Plant Biology -UIUC, MS:Entomology -UIUC, PHD:Entomology -UIUC, MS: Ecol, Evol, Cons Bio -UIUC, or PHD: Ecol, Evol, Cons Bio-UIUC.
